Short Information : has release the answer key for the post of Group ‘Y’ Medical Assistant Airmen trade (Intake 01/2027) on its official website. The application process for Airforce Group Y Medical Assistant Airmen Intake 01/2027 Online Form was carried out from 12 January 2026 to 01 February 2026. The online examination was conducted from 30 , 31 March 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their Airforce Group Y Medical Assistant Airmen Intake 01/2027 Answer Key from the link provided below.

Airforce Group Y/ Medical Assistant Airmen Intake 01/2027 Online Form : Age Limit

  • Medical Assistant trade (10+2) : An unmarried candidate who must have born between 01 January 2006 and 01 January 2010 (both dates inclusive).
  • Medical Assistant trade (Diploma / B.Sc in Pharmacy) :
  • An Unmarried candidate who must have born between 01 January 2003 and 01 January 2008 (both dates inclusive).
  • A Married candidate who must have born between 01 January 2003 and 01 January 2006 (both dates inclusive).
  • Upper Age Limit : 21 Years

Airforce Group Y/ Medical Assistant Airmen Intake 01/2027 Recruitment : Educational Qualification

  • Medical Assistant Trade : Candidates who have have passed 10+2 / Intermediate / Equivalent Examination with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English from Education Boards recognized by Central, State and UT with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate and with 50% marks in English will be considered for this recruitment. OR
  • Candidates have passed two years’ Vocational Course with non-vocational subjects i.e. Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English from Education Boards recognized by Central, State and UT with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English.
  • Medical Assistant Trade (Diploma / B.Sc in Pharmacy) : Candidates who have Diploma / B.Sc in Pharmacy. Candidate should have passed Intermediate/ 10+2/ Equivalent Examination with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English. In addition, Diploma / B.Sc in Pharmacy with minimum 50% marks in aggregate with valid registration from State Pharmacy Council or Pharmacy Council of India (PCI) at the time of enrolment will be mandatory requirement for this recruitment.

Airforce Group Y/ Medical Assistant Airmen Intake 01/2027 Online Form : Physical Eligibility

  • Physical Fitness Test (PFT) :
  1. For candidates up to the age of 21 Years 1.6 Km run to be completed within 7 minutes.
  2. For candidates above 21 years of age and holding Diploma / B.Sc in Pharmacy – 1.6 Km run to be completed within 7 minutes 30 Seconds.
  • Height : Minimum 152.5 cms
  • Cycling – Should be well proportioned and well developed with the minimum range of expansion of 5 cms.
  • Hearing : Candidate should have normal hearing i.e. able to hear forced whisper from a distance of 6 meters by each ear separately.
  • Weight : Proportionate to height and age as applicable for IAF.
  • Dental : Should have healthy gums, good set of teeth and minimum 14 dental points.
  • Visual Standards : 6/36 each eye, correctable to 6/9 each eye; Maximum limits of Refractive Error Not exceeding + 3.50D including Astigmatism.

How To Download Airforce Group Y/ Medical Assistant Airmen Intake 01/2027 Answer Key

  • Check the Important Links section.
  • Then click on the Download Answer Key link.
  • After clicking on the link, candidates will be redirected to the Dashboard page.
  • In this page candidates have to fill up the following fields with proper details:
  • Candidate’s Registration Number
  • Date of Birth
  • Your Answer key will appear on the screen.
  • The candidate can also download it from the official Website.
